representative_papers.title: PAColorHolo: A Perceptually-Aware Color Management Framework for Holographic Displays
representative_papers.problem: Holographic displays struggle with perceptually accurate color reproduction due to system distortions
representative_papers.approach: Color space transformation with adaptive illumination and neural perceptual color response modeling
representative_papers.contribution: Perceptually-aware color management framework improving color fidelity in holographic displays

representative_papers.title: Invisible Holographic Window: Full-color 3D Image Reconstruction from Transparent Surface-relief Computer-generated Holograms
representative_papers.problem: Limited wavelength selectivity in DOEs reduces transmittance, requiring separate CGHs for colors
representative_papers.approach: Spatial frequency domain band-division multiplexing on shallow sinusoidal phase profiles
representative_papers.contribution: Single transparent surface-relief CGH achieving full-color 3D reconstruction on glass

representative_papers.title: Dual-Path Holographic Laser-Excited Volumetric Display
representative_papers.problem: Volumetric displays require improved brightness and voxel density for practical applications
representative_papers.approach: Dual optical paths with femtosecond lasers and synchronized spatial light modulators
representative_papers.contribution: Centimeter-scale volumetric graphics with interactive performance under room lighting

representative_papers.title: MorphSkein: A Shape-Changing Afterimage Display Preserving Pixel Density During Surface-Area Changes Across Troposkein-Based Shapes
representative_papers.problem: Shape-changing displays lose pixel density as surface area expands, limiting usability
representative_papers.approach: Telescopic pole and LED-strip rewinders with troposkein geometry and angular velocity optimization
representative_papers.contribution: Preserves pixel density across expanding axisymmetric shapes via mathematical modeling and interpolation
